family.D1IntersectionUnion: maximum of geometric-mean and nearest-rank-P95 one-sided p-values
family.domainPassRule: valid hard gates and at least four of the five comparator hypotheses pass
family.failedComparatorReporting: every failed comparator hypothesis is reported with effect, simultaneous interval, adjusted p-value, and concrete explanation
family.intervalMultiplicity: two-sided Bonferroni simultaneous intervals over 40 primitive contrasts
family.minimumPracticallyImportantEffectRole: reporting flag only; null boundary unchanged
family.pValueMultiplicity: Holm strong FWER over 35 composite hypotheses
